palette_rule: GBA palette index 0 reserved for transparency; all nine authentic HGSS RGB colors remapped losslessly to indices 1-9.

composition_rule.horizontal: destination columns 0-12 use source 0-12; destination 13-29 use source 15-31, omitting only source columns 13-14
composition_rule.vertical: destination rows 0-17 use source 0-17; destination rows 18-19 use source 22-23, omitting source rows 18-21
composition_rule.visible_footprint: whole authentic tiles only: left 2 columns; top 2 rows from column 13 rightward; rightmost column; full bottom 2 rows. All other cells are transparent so wallpaper/party layers remain visible.

pixel_rule: Every nontransparent output pixel is copied 1:1 from the verified HGSS main-frame source. No source pixel is redrawn, resampled, or recolored.
